rows.observation: 原文的“waves of flame”译为“释放火焰”，漏掉了成波袭来的含义；“wandering minotaurs”的“wandering”也未译出。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes tome-ashes-urhrok/data/lore/demon.lua:356（米诺陶雕像 lore）逐句核对：(1)“a good example of the devious designs the Sher'Tul had in mind while creating or altering Eyal's races”漏译 devious designs（狡诈用心），现译“一个绝妙的例子”反把恶魔叙述者对夏·图尔人的贬斥变成褒义；(2)“the ability to unleash waves of flame”现译“释放火焰的能力”丢了“一波波烈焰”；(3)“some wandering minotaurs accept our cause”漏 wandering（游荡在外、非本土繁育的野生个体），下句“埃亚尔原住民对同胞也不友善”的对照依赖这一限定；(4)“know our cause of righteous revenge”漏 cause；(5)“the children of emerald and ruby”现译“翡翠之子”，本库同文件其余 4 处（tome-ashes-urhrok.lua:522/542/640/642）均作“绿翡翠之子”，对齐库内多数译法。一级忠实度与跨条专名一致性缺陷，整段修。本批文件 SHA 匹配，Ashes 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文“we're not on Eyal anymore”指“我们”已不在埃亚尔，译文改成了“我已不在埃亚尔”。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes tome-ashes-urhrok/data/quests/re-abducted.lua:20 任务名 “I've a feeling we're not on Eyal anymore”，化用《绿野仙踪》“we're not in Kansas anymore”；该任务中玩家被单独劫走，“我已不在埃亚尔”在任务标题语境下成立（上游 zh_hans/zh_hant 亦作“我”），contextual 判 OK。人称取舍属风格，记 advisory，不排修复。本批文件 SHA 匹配，Ashes 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文 Wretchling 译为“酸液树魔”，英文表面含义不含酸液或树木；冻结输入没有术语条目，无法确认该专名译法的依据。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes tome-ashes-urhrok/data/lore/demon.lua:316（夸塞魔雕像 lore）“would devastate a Wretchling or Fire Imp”：同一恶魔 wretchling 在主游戏译“小劣魔”（mod-tome.lua:8452 实体名、11095/13593/13692 小劣魔之眼、13694 任务对话，共 5 行），Ashes 全部 13 行却作“酸液树魔”（tome-ashes-urhrok.lua:128/155/515/518 等），“树魔”无原文依据。纯名称问题，按用户 2026-09-27 指示咨询 Gemini 3.8 Flash（串行，consult-wretchling-358）：推荐统一为“小劣魔”（wretch＝卑劣、-ling＝小型，与火焰小鬼/水小鬼协调）；双向查重：两个译名均无其他英文词占用。采纳，修复窗口先加术语行，再把 Ashes 13 行同步改为“小劣魔”。本批文件 SHA 匹配，Ashes 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文称 Technomancers 是 Archmages，译文却称其为“元素法师”，职业含义不符。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/talents/uber/mag.lua:124/128 Technomancer 是 birth_descriptors subclass Archmage 的职业进阶（is_class_evolution = "Archmage"）；Archmage 在本库是职业名“元素法师”（mod-tome.lua:3021，terminology/classes.tsv birth descriptor name）。“科技法师是涉猎蒸汽科技的元素法师”准确，contextual 判 OK；窗口47b 已同理驳回。本批文件 SHA 匹配，Orcs 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文 unreasonably lethal 指致命程度高得离谱；“最无端致命”误作无缘无故地致命。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/chats/destructicus.lua:30 “This may be the most unreasonably lethal device you've ever seen”：unreasonably lethal 是“致命得离谱/夸张”，现译“最无端致命”把程度副词误作“无缘无故”，一级忠实度错误。contextual 判 OK，宿主按原文确认。本批文件 SHA 匹配，Orcs 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文 Awesome Toss 未指明投掷物，译文“抛枪”限定为枪；冻结输入缺少语境，无法确认这一限定是否准确。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Orcs tome-orcs/data/timed_effects/physical.lua:596–603 效果 on_gain “#Target# tosses steamguns in the air, awesome!”，技能把两把蒸汽枪抛向空中；“华丽抛枪”是用户 2026-09-27 对待审第 35 项按 Gemini 结论裁决的译名（窗口47b 已执行）。contextual 判 OK。驳回。本批文件 SHA 匹配，Orcs 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 语义缺失/误译：demon.lua:356（sha256 d3adada5…，来源未固定）原文 'a good example of the devious designs the Sher'Tul had in mind while creating or altering Eyal's races' 说的是夏·图尔人造改种族时怀有的“狡诈用心”，米诺陶正是其例证；译文“夏·图尔人制造或者改变埃亚尔种族的一个绝妙的例子”漏掉了 devious designs，又添出褒义的“绝妙”，恶魔叙述者对夏·图尔人的贬义立场被反转。另 'some wandering minotaurs' 漏译 wandering（流浪的，指非自家繁育的野生个体），'know our cause of righteous revenge' 漏译 cause（“灌输我们正义的复仇”缺宾语中心）。跨条：本条把 children of emerald 译为“翡翠之子”，同批 d0aff018… 译为“绿翡翠之子”，同一恶魔氏族在同一 lore 文件内（demon.lua:295/316/342/356）应保持一致。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes tome-ashes-urhrok/data/lore/demon.lua:356（米诺陶雕像 lore）逐句核对：(1)“a good example of the devious designs the Sher'Tul had in mind while creating or altering Eyal's races”漏译 devious designs（狡诈用心），现译“一个绝妙的例子”反把恶魔叙述者对夏·图尔人的贬斥变成褒义；(2)“the ability to unleash waves of flame”现译“释放火焰的能力”丢了“一波波烈焰”；(3)“some wandering minotaurs accept our cause”漏 wandering（游荡在外、非本土繁育的野生个体），下句“埃亚尔原住民对同胞也不友善”的对照依赖这一限定；(4)“know our cause of righteous revenge”漏 cause；(5)“the children of emerald and ruby”现译“翡翠之子”，本库同文件其余 4 处（tome-ashes-urhrok.lua:522/542/640/642）均作“绿翡翠之子”，对齐库内多数译法。一级忠实度与跨条专名一致性缺陷，整段修。本批文件 SHA 匹配，Ashes 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 跨条术语不一致：demon.lua:316 的 'children of emerald' 在此译为“绿翡翠之子”，同批 ae4cc0af…（demon.lua:356，'children of emerald and ruby'）译为“翡翠之子”；两者指同一恶魔氏族（demon.lua:295、342 同样用作固定称谓，与 children of ruby/onyx 并列），同一 lore 文件内应统一为一个译名。冻结 envelope 未提供该称谓的术语条目，具体取哪个译名需宿主按术语库裁决。
rows.conclusion: demon.lua:316 本条的“绿翡翠之子”正是本库同文件多数译法（tome-ashes-urhrok.lua:522/542/640/642 共 4 处），不一致出在 ae4cc0af7a 的“翡翠之子”，已在该条确认并对齐；本条此项不需改（本条另因 wretchling 译名确认待修）。本批文件 SHA 匹配，Ashes 来源仓库/commit 未固定。

reviewers.surface: codex/gpt-6-sol (9 lanes: surface-000 four Ashes lanes of 4; surface-001 one Cults full-001 of 1; surface-002 four Orcs lanes of 9)

notes: All-DLC batch of 53 entries (16 Ashes, 1 Cults, 36 Orcs): the remaining window 47a/47b successors. Surface ran as nine gpt-6-sol children in three groups (Ashes 4/4/4/4, Cults full-001 of 1, Orcs 9/9/9/9), all with exact identity echoes. lane-000-2 read its own envelope and the contract partly through an injected Paseo terminal; every key sequence was a read of those two files, and the host killed the terminal after harvest (HOST-SURFACE-BOUNDARY-AUDIT side_effects).

The first contextual pass was replaced: full-001 (Orcs) ran ls /workspace/ to look for source checkouts and was rejected before harvest; full-000 (Ashes) stayed in bounds but is superseded as a diagnostic task. The dlc-location-v1 refreeze named the Ashes checkout (the Orcs envelope is unchanged because the tool only adds Ashes locations); both refreeze runs read only their envelopes, the contract and the named Ashes checkout, and were accepted.

The wretchling name is a pure-name question: per the user's standing instruction it went to Gemini 3.8 Flash (serial consult), which recommended unifying on the main-game 小劣魔; the 13 Ashes lines move off 酸液树魔 in the repair window, after a glossary row is added.
Two surface observations repeat settled names (Archmage class 元素法师, ruled Awesome Toss 华丽抛枪) and are refuted; the Oz-allusion quest title keeps 我 as advisory.
Mixed DLC batch: 16 Ashes, 1 Cults and 36 Orcs entries each matched the public DLC source file SHA in the workset, with the DLC repositories and commits unpinned.
3 confirmed repair revisions raise the window 48 backlog from 6 to 9; below the 20 threshold, so no window opens.
